$comment: Generated by tools/build_plugin.py in davendra/fundadmin-ai. Machine-readable index of every skill and agent in the fundadmin plugin.
name: fundadmin

install.scope: The plugin marketplace is the supported installation route. Claude Code and Cowork install the release published in this repository; in a Codex or ChatGPT workspace an administrator imports the same marketplace and pins a reviewed release tag for the pilot group. Third-party skill installers copy selected raw skill files only.
install.cowork: Customize > Plugins > Add marketplace > davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills > install FundAdmin AI

codex_workspace.route: Workspace settings > Plugins > Add > Import marketplace
codex_workspace.policy: The administrator selects the reviewed immutable release tag rather than a branch, reviews its contents, sets the install policy for the pilot group, and keeps access, data and connected-app permissions under administrator control.

third_party_skill_installers.example: npx skills add davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills --skill fund-review-lpa -a codex
third_party_skill_installers.installs: selected raw skill files in an agent-specific skills directory
third_party_skill_installers.guidance: Developer compatibility only, not a supervised-pilot route. Keep it project-local and name the agent and skills explicitly; do not install globally (-g/--global), with --all, with the --skill '*' wildcard, or non-interactively (-y/--yes).

invocation.auto: Hosts also pick a skill from its description when a user shares a fund document and describes the task.

host_qualification.claude_code: Primary target: installed Claude Code 2.1.278; exact-candidate evidence requires an explicit model trace and all 18 saved cases. Consult the verification record; packaging is not a runtime pass.
host_qualification.codex: Supported package format; runtime experimental/unverified. Direct inline evidence only, not an installed-host matrix. A workspace-managed install is an administrator policy control, not a runtime qualification.
host_qualification.other_agents: Not qualified. Raw skill files copied by a third-party installer run without the packaged agents, helpers and references, so the evidence contract is unavailable and reports are unverified drafts.
host_qualification.private_evidence: Approved storage outside plugin build inputs.

runtime.helpers: standard library, except fund_xlsx.py (openpyxl for .xlsx, CSV otherwise) and generate_fund_pdf.py (requirements-plugin.txt)

disclaimer: Document analysis and drafting support only; not financial, legal or tax advice.

skills.name: fund
skills.description: Main menu and router for the 60 FundAdmin AI skills: fund document review, notice drafting, compliance, negotiation, tracking, analytics, intake and reporting. For bare `/fund` or `/fundadmin:fund` with no subcommand: you MUST ALWAYS invoke this skill via the Skill tool (input matching fund) BEFORE answering, then emit the full 60-command menu including review-lpa, review-capital-call, draft-capital-call, report-pdf. Answering that menu without a Skill tool call is incorrect — do not reconstruct it from memory or catalog alone. Also use when the user asks what the assistant can do, lists commands, or asks for a fund admin task without naming a skill. Route `/fund <cmd>` and `/fundadmin:fund <cmd>` (including wire-verify) to the matching fund-<cmd> skill via the Skill tool. Every output is a draft for qualified human review.
skills.summary: Menu of all commands; routes each request to the matching skill
